info.title: DOGFOOD Local Portal API
info.description: Local REST API for event creation, participation, judging, publication and portability. All writes use JSON. An HttpOnly session cookie or bearer token identifies the caller. Event roles are enforced by the Python service. IDs are opaque strings; times are ISO 8601 with a timezone offset. Browser clients may use the equivalent /dogfood-api prefix. Invites are private bearer links distributed by organizers. Full archive restore requires an empty event. Read API.md for lifecycle and webhook examples.

track_ids.description: null: event-wide; array: allowed track IDs; []: no judging tracks.

url.description: HTTPS URL, or HTTP on localhost/127.0.0.1/::1.

EventArchive.description: Use an unmodified export.json response. Relational IDs are remapped transactionally. Historical accounts are matched by email or locked pending an organizer invitation. Existing credentials and global admin privileges are never overwritten. Includes complete score, voting, comment and publication history; records are newly signed by the destination.

get.description: Returns a consistent archive snapshot. Export and import share a 50,000,000-byte limit and full archives support at most 10,000 rows per table. Export returns 413 rather than an unrestorable download when these limits are exceeded.

post.description: Accepts archive JSON up to 50,000,000 bytes; ordinary JSON endpoints remain limited to 1,000,000 bytes. Full archives support at most 10,000 rows per table. Bodies exceeding the byte limit return 413 before being read.
